notice.heading: Dear Clients,
notice.text: As we survive this extremely hot weather, a little scent advice from us.
notice.skipTitle: Give the heavy Oud and musky scents a little break.
notice.skipText: They can be a bit too intense in this heat.
notice.tryTitle: Instead, go for fruity, floral and citrus scents.
notice.tryText: They feel fresh, light and perfect for the season.
